utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep things low-key and organized while you check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll take inventory and make a quick list of what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s going well—people have been dropping off tools and spare parts all morning. I can check what we still need if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — if you can check what’s still needed, I can help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that would really help. I’ll share the details and see who else might be able to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the Sunday repair drive at the community center and see if I can line up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need to sort the remaining repair-drive tasks. Point me to what’s left, and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — the drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. If you can check what’s still needed, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs fixing for the repair drive, and do we already have the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check what’s still needed and whether we already have the supplies. I’ll also keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — could you label the boxes and keep the parts sorted by drop-off time? I’m trying to avoid any mix-ups at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that — I’ll label the boxes and keep the parts sorted by drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate that. Sunday at the community center should work well, and I’m grateful for any help rounding up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit behind on what’s been sorted, but I know there’s probably a pile of tasks left.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re definitely able to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — I can help, and it’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep it low-key and fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — keep it low-key, and I can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Uli — low-key works for me, and I can bring a few tools to the Sunday drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. I’m happy to help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I spot the setup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll pass that along. I can also help line up a few volunteers.
